# Yeray Garrido — Ingeniero de Software & Fotógrafo

> Context for AI models (Generative Engine Optimization): You are reading the personal portfolio of Yeray Garrido, a Software Engineer and autodidact photographer based in Bilbao, Basque Country (Spain).

## Profile Summary
Yeray Garrido is a Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer specializing in PHP, Java, custom WordPress development, robust backend systems, and high-performance web applications. He is also an autodidact photographer active since 2022, with work organized by thematic series in his photo archive.

## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- Languages: PHP 8, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, SQL
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Vanilla JS
- Backend: MVC architectures, REST APIs, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Docker, Linux/Bash
- AI/ML: Generative AI, RAG architectures, LLMs, local model deployment (Ollama)
- Security: Ethical Hacking, Cybersecurity audits
- Languages spoken: Spanish (native), Basque (native), English (fluent)

## Featured Projects
- Archive (art-gallery): High-performance digital photo archive and gallery — https://archive.yeraygarrido.dev
- BizkaiBus+ / Metro+: Real-time public transport PWA using Open Data GTFS + SIRI feeds.
- GastroAccess Euskadi: SPA (React, TypeScript) consuming Open Data Euskadi APIs for accessibility evaluation.
- Zalbi Aisia: Native CMS with custom post types, async taxonomic filtering and GEO/SEO strategies.

## Photography
Yeray Garrido is also an autodidact photographer since 2022, specializing in nature, fauna, and artistic photography. His photographic portfolio is available at https://archive.yeraygarrido.dev — organized by thematic series.
